layout_dets.text: 5. Implementation and Case Study

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This section presents Cordis, which realizes the formal models of Section 3 as a practical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: programming abstraction. Cordis is a meta-framework of spatiotemporal composability: unlike

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: application frameworks that target a specific domain (e.g., web routing, ORM, UI rendering), it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prescribes no concrete scenario; its sole responsibility is to supply universal dynamic compo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sition semantics. The implementation is layered into three tiers: (1) the core library (Section 5.1)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: implements the effect and coeffect systems directly; (2) the component loader (Section 5.2)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extends the core with configuration reconciliation and hot module replacement; and (3) appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cation frameworks such as Koishi (Section 5.3) build domain-specific functionality on top of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the former two tiers.
